steps.title: Initialize Project & Package Structure
steps.description: Set up build configuration, app-meta.json, AndroidManifest, and package folders for CloudNotes Pro.

steps.title: Define Backend API Schema
steps.description: Create api_schema.json to define online note collections and user authentication operations.

steps.title: Create Backend API Client
steps.description: Implement BackendApi.java to handle register, login, logout, and generic /data CRUD operations securely.

steps.title: Design Premium Authentication Layouts
steps.description: Create modernized activity_login.xml and activity_register.xml with cards, subtle shadows, and polished typography.

steps.title: Implement Login Activity
steps.description: Write LoginActivity.java to authenticate users and manage session tokens.

steps.title: Implement Register Activity
steps.description: Write RegisterActivity.java for new user signups with automatic login integration.

steps.title: Design Premium Main Notes Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml featuring modern header, search bar, card container, and floating action button.

steps.title: Design Premium Note Editor Layout
steps.description: Create activity_note_editor.xml with clean typography, category styling, and action buttons.

steps.title: Design Premium Note List Item Layout
steps.description: Create item_note.xml featuring rounded card backgrounds, category badges, and clean text previews.

steps.title: Implement Note Adapter
steps.description: Write NoteAdapter.java to bind note records to the dashboard list view.

steps.title: Implement Note Editor Activity
steps.description: Write NoteEditorActivity.java to handle creating, updating, and deleting notes via backend API.

steps.title: Implement Main Dashboard Activity
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java to fetch, display, search, and manage user notes from the cloud backend.

steps.title: Building CloudNotes Pro
steps.description: Final validation and build preparation for CloudNotes Pro.
